blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Goa hosts essential scientific institutions dedicated to research, oceanography, and technological growth.
Mining operations have led to notable environmental impacts requiring active monitoring and regulation.
Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ) rules govern sustainable development along Goa's extensive coastline.
Goa possesses diverse flora and fauna, forming a vital part of the Western Ghats biodiversity hotspot.
Transitioning to renewable energy sources is key to Goa's long-term environmental sustainability.

items: Illegal mining led to degradation of forests and rivers in Sanguem, Bicholim, Sattari
Supreme Court cancelled all mining leases in 2018 due to violations
The rivers Kushavati and Valvanta were severely affected by siltation
Goa's coastline is under the Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ) Notification
Illegal construction and encroachments on coastal land are major concerns
Morjim and Agonda beaches have CRZ restrictions due to Olive Ridley turtle nesting

blocks.content: Goa is a globally recognized biodiversity hotspot. The Western Ghats of Goa are home to numerous endemic species.

items: Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ) classifications, rules, and restrictions along Goa's coastal belt.
Environmental degradation, soil erosion, and water pollution caused by historical mining in Goa.
Important scientific research centers headquartered in Goa (e.g., National Institute of Oceanography).
Goa's biodiversity hotspots, sanctuaries, and flora/fauna associated with the Western Ghats.
Flora: Over 3,500 species of plants; 100+ species endemic to the Western Ghats
Fauna: Over 275 species of birds, 60 species of mammals, 275 species of fish
Gaur (Indian Bison), Leopard, Sloth Bear, Malabar Giant Squirrel found in forests
Olive Ridley Turtles nest on Morjim, Agonda, Galgibaga, and Mandrem beaches
Goa Electricity Department manages power distribution
Goa has significant solar energy potential — the state has launched solar rooftop schemes
Tidal energy potential exists due to its extensive coastline
Goa is a pioneer in electric vehicle (EV) adoption through state EV policy
